title: ZeroFeed24
description: The main purpose of this app is to be an on-the-go ADS-B feeder. The app uses the LoRa cap for gps fix, and external RTS-SDR for receive signals from aircrafts, then send them to the services (only flightradar24.com now) using the respective official repo. You can insert your sharing key or submit a request for a new one directly in the app for all the suppoorted feeder. This app is not affiliated or sponsored by flightradar24.com, planefinder.net or airnavradar.com.
